correctness.rationale: Both in the ordinary game and with only f declared, every finishing selection set contains b and d because a and e are undeclared leaves. Also b and d are undeclared and nonadjacent, so any finishing set of size at most three must add their only common neighbor c. With no declaration, indicating f,a,e successively forces c,b,d. With f declared, selecting b,d via a,e leaves only b,d possibly undominated and at most two moves. If an initial indication is one of b,c,d, Staller can choose an outsider a,f,e, respectively. Otherwise b or d is forced, immediately covering c. Neither c nor f can then be indicated, and any later legal indication of b or d can be answered by a leaf (a or e has no other neighbor through which it could already have been selected). Thus Staller can avoid c and rule out any three-move finish. An independent census used all simple (n−1)-edge subsets filtered by connectivity, and a descending covered-set DP, not Prüfer sequences or the packaged selected-set recursion. For a legal indication no neighbor has previously been selected, hence the DP depends only on the covered set. Across 1, 3, 16, 125, 1296 labelled trees the violating counts are 0, 0, 0, 0, 360 respectively, testing all inclusions. Every offending labelled tree has a degree-three center with arms of lengths 1,2,2 (the single isomorphism class of T₀); each had 13 violating nested pairs. The all-r classification of the displayed game values follows from strategies, not the finite replay.
residual_risks: The all-pair search is only for isolate-free trees of orders 2–6, and the two family values concern the empty declaration and {f}, not all declarations on that family.

value.rationale: The result locates exactly where a familiar monotonicity principle first fails within trees, identifies the unique first obstruction even allowing arbitrary nested declarations, and uses one already-dominated leaf to force failure at every larger order. This is stronger and structurally different from finding another cyclic example or computing an arbitrary tree invariant.
residual_risks: No classification of larger offending trees, sizes of larger gaps, or resolution of the separate ordinary-tree equality problem.
